title: Glossier You Duo Perfume Gift Set

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Perfume Gift Sets > Value & Gift Sets > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
✓ Layerable Scent✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy

Scent Type: Warm & Sheer

Key Notes: Pink Pepper, Iris, Ambrox

Set Description: A double dose of Glossier You perfume, just in time for the holidays! Give the gift of a you-but-better scent. Enjoy the ultimate personal fragrance in a bottle and spray.

About the Bottle: The bottle is an objet d’art in its own right. It is crafted in house at Glossier and has the real thumbprint indent of the designer. So just like the scent, the bottle of Glossier You is unfinished. It needs you to hold it, to complete it.

About the Fragrance: The Glossier You Collection are not scents you wear to become someone else.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray scent as desired on your pulse points (your neck, behind your ears, your wrists, and more).
-Allow fragrance to settle for a few moments rather than rubbing it in (as this can disrupt the scent).
-Apply post-shower, after moisturizing to aid absorption for a longer, stronger scent impact.
Ingredients+

Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Hydroxycitronellal, Linalyl Acetate, Hexadecanolactone, Farnesol, Pinene, Limonene, Rose Ketones, Beta-Caryophyllene.
